core_conclusion: The sealed HUP080 outer evaluation displays channel-wise observed, free, reference, and controlled occupation laws for the frozen partial-actuation controller across all 96 channels, while direct/indirect actuation and Gate status remain externally supplied rather than visually inferred.

source_data: Approved HUP080 run04 context07/bank0 preview, its canonical O/F/R/C input, and independently audited GO binding
integrity_note: No data, axes, page assignment, channel order, line style, W1 value, gate vector, or scientific result is changed. Relative to package_overleaf_final, the only visible revision is the publication summary wording from 'Sparse direct actuation' to 'Direct actuation'.
reviewer_risk: Direct actuation covers 76/96 channels (79.2%), so this package avoids characterizing the controller as sparse. The displayed curves and W1 labels are from the pre-frozen representative outer-context-07/bank0 view; supplied Gate outcomes summarize the frozen 8-context by 3-bank outer evaluation and must not be inferred from curve overlap. The final 12 cells on page 3 are intentionally blank, not missing channels.
